params.name: siteId
params.description: Restrict to inspections for a single site.

params.name: missionId
params.description: Restrict to inspections for a single mission.

params.name: assetId
params.description: Restrict to inspections that contain at least one asset inspection for this asset.

params.name: hasComments
params.description: When `true`, restrict to inspections that have at least one comment on any associated media (site-level via `site_inspection_media`, or asset-level via the site's `asset_inspections`). Any other value is treated as absent.

params.name: siteName
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match (ILIKE) on the joined site's `name`. Pass plain text; the server wraps it with `%` on both sides.

params.name: siteType[]
params.description: Repeating allowlist on the joined site's `site_type`. Empty/absent means any.

params.name: geometryType[]
params.description: Repeating GeoJSON geometry-type allowlist on the joined site's geometry (mapped to `ST_GeometryType` internally). Empty/absent means any.

params.name: priority[]
params.description: Repeating allowlist on the denormalized `sites.priority` column (`none` also matches a NULL priority). Empty/absent means any.

params.name: resolution[]
params.description: Repeating allowlist bucketing each site inspection by its defects' `workDoneAt` flags: `all_resolved` (every defect resolved), `some_resolved` (a mix), `none_resolved` (at least one defect, none resolved). Site inspections with zero defects match no bucket and are excluded when this filter is active.

params.name: review[]
params.description: Repeating allowlist bucketing each site inspection by its defects' `reviewedAt` flags: `all_reviewed` (every defect reviewed), `some_reviewed` (a mix), `none_reviewed` (at least one defect, none reviewed). Site inspections with zero defects match no bucket and are excluded when this filter is active.

params.name: includeUncapturable
params.description: When `true`, additionally returns synthesized placeholder SiteInspection rows for mission sites tagged `inaccessible` that have no persisted inspection (no media was captured). Requires `missionId`; sending it without `missionId` is a `400`. Placeholder rows carry `not_capturable: true`, reuse the site's id, and expand a `site` whose `tags` include `inaccessible`. They pass through the same filters and pagination as real rows.

params.name: mediaSource[]
params.description: Optional allowlist applied to expanded `media` rows. When supplied, only `mission_media` rows whose `source` is in the list are returned in the expanded `media` field; non-media expansions (e.g. `site`, `cluster`) ignore the filter. Empty/omitted means no filtering. The dashboard's site-level photo carousel uses this to keep `cvat_crop` derivative crops out while still letting `/asset-inspections` surface them under `asset_inspection_media`. Allowed values mirror the `mission_media.source` CHECK constraint.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size (default 50, max 200)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response

items.docs: Returns SiteInspection records for the caller's organization. All filter parameters are optional; row-level security confines results to the caller's organization.
